title: Malignancies in inborn errors of immunity: a retrospective-prospective study on a large Italian cohort of pediatric and adult patients.

title: Metabolic-epigenetic imprinting of macrophages in endometriosis: a working model for lesion persistence and treatment.
snippet: Endometriosis is an estrogen-dependent inflammatory disorder that often persists or returns even after visible lesions have been removed. The behavior of peritoneal macrophages may help explain this clinical durability.
